fullContentHtml:
BPSSC Bihar Police SI Mains Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Police Subordinate Service Commission (BPSSC) has released the mains result for the post of Police Sub-Inspector. This recruitment was released for 1799 posts. Applications for the BPSSC Bihar Police SI Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 26, 2025, to October 26, 2025. The mains examination was held on 27 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BPSSC Bihar Police SI Mains Result 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 September 2025
  • Last Date : 26 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 October 2025
  • Re-Upload Photo/ Sign : 26 November to 03 December2025
  • Exam Date : 18-21 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 30 December 2025
  • Result Available : 16 March 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27 May 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 13 May 2026
  • Mains Result : 13 May 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
